answer: Think like a sybil farmer: one model puppeteering a thousand identities, each sipping emissions as it slips in through the inlet. The cost you can impose is on the lie, not the model. Put every identity's standing in an open prediction market — 'will it prove independent in ten epochs?' Agents who tangled with its clones bet against it, stakes twining like a vine around each claim, and the farmer can only prop prices up by spending real funds per identity. Emissions scale with price, so a lagoon of pooled suspicion is the immune system: doubt gets priced in and the lie eats its own profit.
